description: Prove the developer owns the domain of their MCP server or API. Going live does not need it: an unverified Cap is live and charges callers, but the developer's earnings from it stay frozen until this passes — verifying releases them. Call with the service's https url: if the domain (or a parent domain) is already verified it says so; otherwise it returns a one-line file to serve at /.well-known/qumge-verify.txt on that host (or a DNS TXT record with the same line). Put the file into the project so it ships with the next deploy, then call again with check: true. Needs the developer's Qumge key.

check.description: true = look for the line now (after the user deployed it).

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

url.description: The service's https url, e.g. https://api.example.com/mcp

name: verify_domain
